data_objects.name: abalone_measurements
data_objects.meaning: Individual abalone records containing a sex or life-stage code, shell dimensions, body-component weights, and ring count.
data_objects.notes: Physical measurement units and the codebook for Sex are not provided in the table.

variables.name: Sex
variables.meaning: Categorical sex or life-stage code for the individual.

variables.name: Length
variables.meaning: Length measurement of the abalone shell or body.

variables.name: Diameter
variables.meaning: Diameter measurement of the abalone shell or body.

variables.name: Height
variables.meaning: Height measurement of the abalone shell or body.

variables.name: Shucked weight
variables.meaning: Weight of the shucked edible body.

variables.name: Rings
variables.meaning: Count of growth rings recorded for the individual.

structure.description: Each row represents one measured abalone; no explicit individual identifier is included.
Whole weight is accompanied by separate shucked, viscera, and shell component-weight fields.

uncertainties: The meanings of the Sex category codes are not declared by train.csv.
Length and weight units, collection setting, and measurement procedures are unspecified.
annotation_notes: No physical units or category expansions are assigned where they are not established by train.csv.
